## Relaxed Indoor Family Day in Tokyo — 2026-10-10
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

A low-stress, indoor-only plan for 2 adults and 2 children, with just 3 planned stops and a dinner booking around **18:30**. I’m assuming you want easy transit by taxi or subway and minimal walking between activities.

## Tokyo Family Schedule: 3 Stops, Gentle Pace
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Time | Stop | Duration | Transition | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 09:30–11:30 | **Tokyo Toy Museum** | 2h | 20 min | Hands-on, child-friendly, great for ages 7 and 10 |
| 11:50–14:10 | **Lunch + teamLab Planets TOKYO** | 2h 20m | 15 min | Eat first, then a fully indoor immersive art visit |
| 14:25–16:45 | **Tokyo Station / Marunouchi indoor break** | 2h 20m | 25 min | Relaxed shopping, cafés, and a quiet rest stop |
| 18:30–20:00 | **Dinner reservation** | 1h 30m | 30–45 min buffer | Book near Marunouchi, Tokyo Station, or Ginza for easiest evening flow |

### Morning: Tokyo Toy Museum

- **09:30–11:30**
- Start the day with a playful indoor activity that works well for children and adults.
- Keep the pace easy: arrive, explore, and leave without rushing.
- Transition to lunch: **20 min** by taxi or local train.

### Afternoon: Lunch and teamLab Planets TOKYO
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/paint-bucket.svg

- **11:50–12:40** lunch nearby
- **12:55–14:10** teamLab Planets TOKYO
- This gives the children a break before the more immersive second stop.
- Transition to the next stop: **15 min**.

### Late Afternoon: Tokyo Station / Marunouchi Indoor Break
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

- **14:25–16:45**
- Use this as the calmest part of the day: café time, souvenir browsing, or a short sit-down snack.
- Good backup if anyone needs an earlier rest before dinner.
- Transition to dinner: **25 min** plus a little buffer.

### Evening: Dinner Around 18:30
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

- **18:30–20:00**
- Best areas for an easy family dinner: **Marunouchi, Tokyo Station, Ginza**
- Choose a restaurant with:
  - reserved seating
  - children’s menu or flexible sharing plates
  - quick access to transit afterward
- Keep **30–45 minutes** of buffer before the reservation for a smooth arrival.

## Best Fit for This Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

- **Most relaxed flow:** Toy Museum → lunch → teamLab Planets → indoor break → dinner
- **Best for kids:** one hands-on stop, one visual stop, one calm stop
- **Least tiring:** only **3 planned stops** and short transitions throughout the day
